name: agent-question-form
title: Agent Question Form
description: An agent asks one to five questions at once: options with their descriptions in view, the first recommended unless turned off, own words and a note per question, previews, steps and a review; and the read-only answers.

meta.whenToUse: An agent that needs the person's choice before it goes on: one quick pick, or a batch of questions with options, previews and own words.
meta.whenNotToUse: An agent asking to perform one action (ApprovalCard), offering a next step the person may ignore (SuggestionCard), or a survey the host defines itself (Questionnaire).
